description.value: A seasonal BC Parks beach campground near Courtenay on Vancouver Island, offering 65 sites with potable water and washrooms; access is summer-only as the gate is locked off-season.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms this is a real, active provincial park (Kitty Coleman Beach Park) operated by BC Parks, though the OSM operator tag reads 'local community board.' — a discrepancy. The fetched website content captured only site-wide navigation and no park-specific amenity details, so nearly all optional amenities must remain null. The OSM tags provide capacity (65 sites) and a phone number, but neither the website nor OSM supply enough detail to confirm individual facilities.
concerns: OSM operator tag reads 'local community board.' but the website identifies this as a BC Parks (provincial government) facility — the operator tag appears incorrect.
Website fetch returned only site-wide navigation content; no park-specific amenity or facility details were captured, leaving most amenity fields unverifiable.
The BC Parks URL format (env.gov.bc.ca) is an older pattern; the canonical BC Parks site may have migrated, potentially causing the subpage 404s observed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operational BC Parks campground with 65 sites confirmed via the provincial parks website; straightforwardly useful to touring cyclists on Vancouver Island.
